timed_pipeline: scan and parse the complete provider transcript
atomically commit observations, receipts, cursors, and projection work
drain the production projector and V1 fold
bounded replay of every committed observation
no_op_replay: repeat the same production ingest and bounded replay against the durable end cursor; require zero observation-count change and zero coordinator work counters

metrics.latency: monotonic-clock batch nanoseconds; nearest-rank p50/p95/p99 plus min/max/mean/sample standard deviation
metrics.throughput: committed and replayed input records divided by summed timed-pipeline duration
metrics.cpu: Linux /proc/self/stat user plus system ticks for timed code only, converted with getconf CLK_TCK
metrics.peak_memory: Linux /proc/self/status VmHWM after /proc/self/clear_refs reset immediately before each measured pipeline
metrics.bytes_written: Linux /proc/self/io write_bytes delta while the production pipeline runs; the process performs no other file writes in the interval
metrics.database_storage_growth: sum of SQLite database, WAL, and SHM file-length growth
metrics.no_op_work: latency, CPU ticks, process write bytes, database storage growth, observation-count delta, and every coordinator work counter
metrics.raw_samples: each measured repetition preserves latency, CPU ticks, process write bytes, database storage growth, peak RSS, and replayed observation count
